cohortCounts.eligibilityDefinition: Included, non-nullified plays without field-boundary, scouting, event-agreement or heuristic trajectory flags; this is an analysis filter, not a legal or medical determination.

meta.note: Source CSVs are 2021 season data (weeks 1–8), regardless of the hackathon or repository date. Demo contains two games unless explicitly selected. Tracking is sampled at 10 Hz; frameId supplies timing because timestamps have whole-second precision. Replay begins at ball_snap and stops at pass_forward, or the observed endpoint for sacks/scrambles. Separation measures distance to PFF Coverage players, not all defenders or catch probability. Open time is an illustrative >=3-yard threshold.

stories.title: Engram receives +2.64 yards of Coverage Lift
stories.caption: From 1.6s to 2.1s, Evan Engram gains 1.09 yards of separation: coverage movement contributes +2.64 yards and receiver movement contributes -1.54. He stays beyond the line and above 3 yards of separation from 2.1s through the 3.1s release. This describes spacing, not who caused the coverage movement.

stories.title: Hill opens through receiver movement
stories.caption: Between 1.8s and 2.3s, Hill's separation rises 1.66 yards. Receiver movement contributes +1.76 yards while Coverage Lift is -0.10 yards. Compare with Engram's opening to distinguish two geometric sources of space.

stories.title: Hardman's window closes before the throw
stories.caption: Mecole Hardman reopens a downfield window at 3.1s: 3.22 yards of separation, 20.03 yards past the line. Separation reaches 10.13 yards at 4.1s, drops below 3 yards at 6.2s, and is 1.79 yards at the 7.2s release. Julian Love is the nearest coverage defender during the closing phase.

stories.title: Same play, different space
stories.caption: From 1.5s to the 2.9s release, Chris Godwin stays within 2.13 yards of Anthony Brown. Over the same downfield interval, Rob Gronkowski's separation from Keanu Neal grows from 3.05 to 6.27 yards. The paired replay shows the spacing contrast without assuming either route caused the other to open.
